entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec installs a collection, let alone one with thousands of members.
entries.pass: No single main-thread freeze over 10 s in any phase of the install (and of the update with --update), and the review says complete.

entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec installs a collection or fails a download.
entries.pass: The first install does not claim complete while a member's downloads failed, and Resume installs that member.

entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec downloads and installs a real Nexus collection.
entries.pass: Every required member of the collection installs, its deployed files match their SHA-256, and purge removes them.

entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec measures what concurrent downloads cost persistence and the renderer.
Vortex's mods specs use a handful of mods; none renders, filters or deploys a library of thousands.
entries.pass: At most 200 Mods rows rendered, clearing a filter blocks under 2 s, no blank rows at any depth, no task over 1.5 s across 10 installs, and a modern-layout deploy within 1.6 times the classic one.

entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec scrolls the Mods table with real wheel input.
entries.pass: At most 200 rows on arrival, no wheel-flick frame gap over 300 ms, no blank rows 1 s after scrolling, edge dropdowns open inside the scroll area, and the Status column never narrows back.

entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec opens the Plugins page; it needs a Bethesda game.
entries.pass: At most 200 plugin rows rendered, no scroll, filter, clear or toggle blocks the renderer over 1.5 s, and every row follows its toggle.

entries.why: No Vortex e2e spec follows a plugin's Mod link to the Mods page.
entries.pass: Clicking a plugin's Mod link opens the Mods page with that mod's row on screen, for the last-sorted mod and then the first.

entries.why: Vortex's health-check specs do not cover Missing Masters, a collection's check suppression or the game-version prompt.
entries.pass: Missing Masters flags a plugin whose master is absent (A), and again straight after an offline collection's review is closed with Done (B; B fails on Vortex <= 2.8, Nexus-Mods/Vortex#24282); the collection's postprocess fires and applies its plugin list; the game-version prompt appears and Continue completes the install (C).
